review.rationale: Output Y provides significantly better narrative utility and character agency. While both outputs correctly identify that Iris is tired of the player's talking, X remains passive ('I don't know yet') and repeats previous sentiments about silence without advancing the scene. Y actively proposes a next step (exploring the floor or the stair), which breaks the conversational loop and moves the game forward. However, Y contains a minor factual continuity error regarding Iris's posture (standing vs. sitting) compared to the immediate prior turn, whereas X maintains physical consistency. Despite the physical inconsistency in Y, its superior handling of relationship dynamics and plot progression makes it the stronger response for gameplay.
continuity_evidence: Prior turns establish Iris sitting on stools (Turns 1-8). Output X keeps her seated; Output Y places her standing near a cabinet.
Turn 6 established Iris saying 'You've been doing most of the talking' and asking Nicco to tell her what he is planning. Output Y references this ('You've covered a good deal') and pivots to action.
The room description consistently includes beds, nightstands, wardrobes, and medical cabinets. Both outputs reference these elements accurately.
